title: Class-unit core representations
objective: Implement factored number-field elements, immutable proof states, shared ClassUnitGroupContext state/serialization, and corruption-resistant replay tests

handoff.summary: Added canonical FactoredNumberFieldElement arithmetic and authenticated replay, immutable exact proof labels and ResourceLimits, and a shared duck-typed ClassUnitGroupContext with policy-separated cache keys, proof forks, component update helpers, SHA-256 checkpoints, decoders, and producer verifiers. The frozen quadratic fixture and focused test cover exact expansion/norm/principal ideals/logarithms, portable replay, all four proof labels, immutable policy state, 19 component mutations, recomputed-hash identity/label failures, noncanonical factors, and semantic relation rejection.
risks: Context component authentication detects accidental mutation, while mathematical semantics remain intentionally owned by producer-supplied replay verifiers.
The lane did not claim pyrightconfig.json or package exports; integration must register both strict modules and any desired public re-exports.
Broad native and merged-suite gates were deferred to integration at coordinator request; the recorded receipts are the focused Sage.js runtime regression and direct zero-error Pyright check.
next_steps: Add factored_elements.py and class_unit_context.py to pyrightconfig.json in the integration lane.
Wire factor-base, relation, matrix, unit/analytic, and map/proof record decoders and verifiers into ClassUnitGroupContext replay.
Run pnpm test:baselib:strict, pnpm test:native, pnpm architecture:check, and pnpm test:changed after all class/unit lanes merge.
